label: Source support for f586a11b from I q.19 a.1 co. and ad 2
note: The body treats intellectually apprehended good as an object of will, rather than requiring deficient seeking. Applying this to the target requires every appetitive principle satisfying FollowsIntellect to amount to that orientation to intellectually apprehended good, and the orientation to warrant HasWill for the same bearer without treating divine willing as a distinct passive capacity.
